title: Trees in the U.S. vs Jakarta

cards.prompt: How do summer trees in Jakarta generally compare to trees in the U.S. in leaf color and thickness?
cards.answer: Jakarta trees look thicker, bigger and greener; U.S. trees look thinner, lighter and yellowish.

cards.prompt: Why do Jakarta leaves have high chlorophyll a and b concentration?
cards.answer: Because of intense sunlight, chlorophyll protects plant cells.

cards.prompt: Name three U.S. temperate trees that generally have thinner leaves.
Jakarta leaves look plump and lush because of high humidity around ____.
U.S. temperate trees have thinner leaves because they produce a higher density of chlorophyll.
cards.answer: Myth: they produce a lower density of chlorophyll.
